name: Biomonitor
effect: Internal readout of vitals; warns before you flatline.
tradeoff: None. Pure utility chrome.
flavor: A nagging little voice that knows your heart rate.

name: Light Tattoo
effect: Subdermal glow art; +1 to first-impression style checks in nightlife.
tradeoff: None mechanically. You glow in the dark.
flavor: Wear your mood on your skin, literally.

name: Chemskin
effect: Recolor skin at will; disguise/persuasion edge in specific scenes.
tradeoff: None.
flavor: This season's skin is matte black.

name: Neural Link
effect: REQUIRED backbone for most neuralware, cyberdecks, smartguns, interface plugs.
tradeoff: The first real intrusion into the meat.
flavor: The wire that makes you part machine.

name: Interface Plugs
effect: Jack into NET architecture and smart vehicles directly. Netrunner enabler.
tradeoff: Open ports are a two-way door.
flavor: Cable in the wrist. Welcome to the deep end.

name: Sandevistan (Speedware)
effect: Boost REF/initiative for a few rounds on activation. Solo's edge.
tradeoff: Time slows; your humanity bleeds with it.
flavor: For a few seconds, the world holds still and you don't.

name: Chipware Socket
effect: Slot skill chips for temporary skill ranks.
tradeoff: Borrowed talent never feels like your own.
flavor: Plug in the lesson; skip the years.

name: Cybereye
effect: Replacement eye with option slots (buy one per eye).
tradeoff: You see better. You feel a little less.
flavor: The pupil that never dilates.

name: Low Light / IR / UV
effect: See in the dark; +2 perception in low light. Stealth ops staple.
tradeoff: Option for an existing cybereye.
flavor: The night stops hiding things from you.

name: Targeting Scope
effect: +1 to ranged attacks with a smartlinked weapon.
tradeoff: Option for an existing cybereye.
flavor: A crosshair only you can see.

name: Cyberaudio Suite
effect: Base for audio options (radio, scrambler, amplified hearing).
tradeoff: Always-on ears never fully switch off.
flavor: The city's hum becomes a channel you can tune.

name: Amplified Hearing
effect: +2 to hearing-based perception; eavesdrop through walls.
tradeoff: Option for the cyberaudio suite.
flavor: You hear the safety click off two rooms away.

name: Radio Comms Link
effect: Silent crew comms during a run; coordination bonus.
tradeoff: Option for the cyberaudio suite.
flavor: The whole crew in your skull, for better or worse.

name: Subdermal Armor
effect: + armor under the skin; stacks lightly with worn armor.
tradeoff: Heavier humanity hit for staying alive.
flavor: Bullets meet weave before they meet you.

name: Independent Air Supply
effect: Breathe in gas/underwater for minutes; ignore some hazards.
tradeoff: Machinery where lungs used to matter.
flavor: You stopped trusting the air a while ago.

name: Toxin Binders
effect: +2 to resist poisons, drugs, and biotoxins.
tradeoff: Your body filters chemistry like a machine.
flavor: Hard to poison a filter.

name: Cyberarm
effect: +BODY for arm tasks; option slots for tools/weapons.
tradeoff: A limb you can upgrade is a limb you can lose feeling in.
flavor: Stronger than meat, and it shows.

name: Cyberleg
effect: +MOVE / leaping; option slots (e.g., grip feet).
tradeoff: You walk differently now. People notice.
flavor: The ground feels further away.

name: Popup Melee (Rippers)
effect: Concealed blades; lethal unarmed damage, surprise edge.
tradeoff: Option requiring a cyberarm. Hard on humanity.
flavor: Your hands are always armed; that's the problem.

name: Linear Frame (Sigma)
effect: Massive BODY/strength boost; carry and hit like a machine.
tradeoff: Deep borg conversion. Heavy humanity cost.
flavor: More exoskeleton than person now.

name: Full Borg Conversion
effect: Replace most of the body; top-tier durability and power.
tradeoff: The brink of cyberpsychosis. Rarely survives the soul intact.
flavor: They kept the brain. Mostly.

name: Big Knucks
effect: Reinforced knuckles; stronger melee strikes.
tradeoff: Option requiring a cyberarm.
flavor: A handshake you won't forget.

name: Popup Ranged Weapon
effect: Concealed pistol/SMG in the arm; surprise ranged attack.
tradeoff: Option requiring a cyberarm. Steep humanity hit.
flavor: You're never unarmed. Customs hate you.
